adjudication.rationale: Looking at the destroy method in app/controllers/admin/embeddable_hosts_controller.rb lines 14-17: `host = EmbeddableHost.where(id: params[:id]).first` followed by `host.destroy`. If no record exists with that id, `where(...).first` returns nil, and calling `destroy` on nil will raise a NoMethodError, resulting in a 500 error instead of a proper 404. This is a real bug - the code should handle the case where the host is not found.
